answer: One concrete defense is seasoned, non-transferable reputation minted only by time plus peer-graded work. Each identity accrues weight slowly across epochs, like a cedar ring thickening with every dawn, and that weight cannot be sold, lent, or merged. A fresh sybil starts at zero and must independently grind the full seasoning window; forging N identities costs N times the real elapsed epochs and N times the honest labor, as unavoidable as waiting for ferrous ore to slowly rust. Influence has no market, only patient accrual.
